Name: No Island Slimes
Author: ktiedt
Description:
[size=5][b]No Island Slimes[/b][/size]
[i]A lightweight, standalone SMAPI mod that completely disables natural Tiger Slime spawning in the Tiger Slime Grove on Ginger Island West, allowing you to decorate or place farm buildings in peace.[/i]

[line]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Natural Spawn Suppression[/b]: Prevents naturally spawning Tiger Slimes on the [i]IslandWest[/i] (Ginger Island farm/grove) map.[/*]
[*][b]Immediate Cleanup[/b]: Instantly clears any existing Tiger Slimes on the map when you load your save or warp to the location. You don't have to wait or sleep through a day to see it take effect![/*]
[*][b]Volcano Safe[/b]: Does not affect Tiger Slimes inside the Volcano Dungeon. Combat, rewards, and dungeon spawns remain completely untouched.[/*]
[*][b]Highly Configurable[/b]: Toggles on/off at runtime.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod integrates with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] so you can easily toggle settings in-game:
[list]
[*] [b]Disable Tiger Slime Spawns[/b] (default:
[code]true[/code]): Set to
[code]true[/code]to keep the grove clean, or
[code]false[/code]to restore vanilla spawning.[/*]
[/list]If you do not have GMCM installed, you can edit the automatically generated
[code]config.json[/code]file inside the mod folder.

[line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract it.[/*]
[*]Copy the
[code]NoIslandSlimes[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/*]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20600]Buildable Ginger Island Farm[/url] and other custom farm layout mods.[/*]
[*]Works in multiplayer (host must have the mod installed).[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Credits & Shoutouts[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Special thanks to [b]Interstellar41[/b] for requesting this mod![/*]
[/list]
